title: Risk Pattern Specification
rationale: The reusable pattern remains a documentary specialization. The comparison with intended steps is useful context, not a requirement that every pattern express an intention or be an execution plan.
context_interpretation: RX-002 links a continuing analytical case to its pattern; it does not identify the two. The inherited documentary identity and excluded blanket artifact set do not supply a Plan equivalence or register-approval condition.

title: Risk Context Specification
rationale: The context specification retains boundaries, horizon and objective references. Generic entity context does not supply that schema or its version policy.
context_interpretation: R-35/RX-001 now refer to the explicitly analytical RiskCase. Missing task inputs concern readiness under a declared profile, not nonexistence or formal admission of that case.

title: Risk Scenario Specification
rationale: Retain a bounded analogy to the security scenario entry. Riskium describes possible developments about continuing cases, with a broader stated risk scope.
context_interpretation: R-36 separates a scenario from its analytical case and R-25 does not turn a specification into an actual occurrence. Inherited artifact identity remains documentary, without blanket sibling exclusion.

title: Risk Nature Assertion
rationale: Retain contextual classification as a related use. The compared classifying term is a motivation instance, not the class of RiskNatureAssertion or proof of favorable/unfavorable meaning.
context_interpretation: R-41/R-42/R-43 keep the claim about a case, selected nature value and context separate. The analytical case reading leaves nature objective-relative; the claim does not establish truth by classification.

title: Nature Term
rationale: Retain the resource/label distinction. A NatureTerm is a controlled scheme-qualified vocabulary resource, whose wording alone does not determine its identity.
context_interpretation: The path through ClassificationTerm and VocabularyConcept preserves InformationArtifact identity. The retained GS-RKM-C019/GS-RKM-C017 groups are non-disjoint and incomplete; their source labels remain carried, not independently validated here.

title: Vocabulary Concept
rationale: Retain vocabulary-concept and lexical-label context. A Riskium vocabulary resource is not automatically its referent or an OWL domain universal; the source also permits dual typing, so no global disjointness is inferred.
context_interpretation: G2-052 preserves documentary identity and the explicit GS-RKM-C017 policy does not make its listed subtypes exhaustive. Excluding the blanket artifact set leaves these subtype edges intact.

title: Classification Scheme
rationale: Retain the concept-scheme comparison without asserting identical extension. Scope, governance and version policy are additional Riskium commitments.
context_interpretation: GX-049 preserves artifact identity. R-05 records term membership under this profile; it is not a claim that the external scheme is closed or that the listed terms exhaust every possible member.

title: Classification Term
rationale: Retain the controlled-resource/label distinction. The selected scheme and version context qualify a classification value; lexical equality is not a universal or resource identity rule.
context_interpretation: G2-053/G2-052 preserve the inherited documentary identity. GS-RKM-C019 and GS-RKM-C017 remain explicitly non-disjoint and incomplete; no new covering, exclusivity or semantic-module claim is added.

title: Classification Assertion
rationale: Retain the distinction between a classification statement and its target. Annotation and classifying motivation inform this comparison without supplying Riskium source/context qualification or a formal class alignment.
context_interpretation: R-03 can classify an analytically identified RiskCase before organizational register admission. R-04/R-29 keep the selected term and documenting entry separate from the case and assertion.

title: Tag
rationale: Retain tagging motivation and lexical-label context. The motivation instance is distinct from a Riskium tag artifact; identical words do not identify an assignment or imply a formal taxonomy.
context_interpretation: G2-054 preserves artifact identity and R-24 links the tag to an entry revision. Excluding blanket artifact sibling grouping neither merges tags with classification terms nor makes all document types exclusive.

title: Risk Source Reference
rationale: Retain the document/referent contrast. A managed contributor reference may describe an unresolved or hypothetical contributor; it is not that contributor or evidence of actual causation.
context_interpretation: G3-001 supplies documentary identity. RK3-001 concerns an analytical RiskCase; RK3-002 is the distinct source-resolution link and RK3-003 supplies context. No universal bearer category or operational-admission requirement is introduced.
